simulation_notice: All assets, telemetry, incidents and assessments are synthetic and produced by the SentinelSwitch digital twin. No real network was assessed.

organization.name: Meridian Esports League
organization.context: The twin is presented as a segmented esports tournament network: production workstations and player stations on the USERS VLAN, tournament services on the SERVERS VLAN, spectator and vendor access on the GUEST VLAN, broadcast/NOC monitoring on the MONITORING VLAN. The assets, telemetry and incidents are simulated; the controls and workflow apply to any enterprise access layer.

vlans.name: MGMT
vlans.purpose: Network management plane (switch SVI, jump host, security stack management)

vlans.name: USERS
vlans.purpose: Production workstations, tournament admin and player stations (802.1X)

vlans.name: SERVERS
vlans.purpose: Tournament services (directory, files, RADIUS, intranet, git/CI, updates)

vlans.name: GUEST
vlans.purpose: Spectator, vendor and event-floor devices (internet only)

vlans.name: MONITORING
vlans.purpose: Broadcast/NOC monitoring: security telemetry collector and controller

states.PASS: available evidence demonstrates the condition is satisfied
states.FAIL: available evidence demonstrates the condition is not satisfied
states.UNKNOWN: evidence is insufficient to decide; never counted as a pass
states.STALE: evidence is older than the control's freshness window at the assessment clock; never counted as a pass

methodology.freshness: per-control windows measured against the simulated clock; state-based evidence is read live from the twin and has no window

metrics.coverage_pct: share of assessments with a determinate result (PASS or FAIL); UNKNOWN and STALE are excluded from the numerator
metrics.pass_rate_of_determinate_pct: PASS divided by (PASS + FAIL); this is control effectiveness among determinate results, not overall compliance
metrics.pass_rate_of_all_pct: PASS divided by all assessments; UNKNOWN and STALE count against it
metrics.open_findings: findings whose status is open, reopened, remediation_requested, remediated (awaiting verification) or remediation_failed
metrics.retired: latest results whose scope no longer exists (for example a resolved incident); kept in history, excluded from every total above

controls.name: Access port carries its intended VLAN
controls.description: Every configured access port is in the VLAN declared in the port intent, unless an authorized and verified containment workflow moved it to the quarantine VLAN.
controls.source_of_truth: simulator/fixtures/environment.yaml port intent vs SwitchTwin.interfaces[*].access_vlan, quarantine flags and containment_actions

csf.text: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage
Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

controls.remediation: Re-apply the intended access VLAN from the port template (switchport access vlan <intent>).

controls.name: 802.1X / MAB enforced on user ports
controls.description: Ports in the user-port profile run 802.1X with MAB fallback (authentication port-control auto, mab).

csf.text: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated
Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

controls.name: Connected endpoints have a verified identity
controls.description: Every MAC learned on a connected access port belongs to an inventoried asset with a recent authentication result. Identity evidence older than the re-authentication period is reported as STALE.
controls.source_of_truth: SwitchTwin.mac_table + inventory (devices table) + auth_events (last RADIUS result per MAC)

csf.text: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained
Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

controls.remediation: Register the asset in the inventory or re-authenticate the session (clear authentication sessions interface <port>).
controls.limitations: Guest-VLAN sessions have no periodic re-authentication, so their identity evidence ages until the port is bounced.

controls.name: Port security matches the port profile
controls.description: Port security is enabled with the profile's maximum address count, violation mode and sticky setting on every access port that requires it.

csf.text: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage
Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

controls.remediation: Re-apply the port-security lines from the port template.

controls.name: Interface configuration matches the baseline
controls.description: No configuration drift between the rendered baseline (configuration as code) and the observed running configuration for the interface.
controls.source_of_truth: DriftEngine (desired intent vs observed twin settings)

csf.text: Configuration management practices are established and applied

controls.remediation: Apply the recommended IOS commands produced by the drift engine.

controls.name: Unused ports are shut down and parked
controls.description: Every port without an assigned asset is administratively down and parked in the black-hole VLAN 999.
controls.source_of_truth: port intent class 'unused' vs SwitchTwin.interfaces[*].admin_status / access_vlan

csf.text: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage
Configuration management practices are established and applied

controls.remediation: shutdown + switchport access vlan 999 on each listed port.

controls.name: DHCP snooping / DAI trust limited to infrastructure trunks
controls.description: Only the protected infrastructure trunks are DHCP-snooping and ARP-inspection trusted; every access port is untrusted.
controls.source_of_truth: SwitchTwin.interfaces[*].settings dhcp_snooping_trust / dai_trust vs port intent protected trunks

csf.text: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

controls.remediation: Remove trust from non-infrastructure ports; add trust to protected trunks.

controls.name: Required telemetry sources are current
controls.description: The SPAN feed (Zeek), RADIUS accounting and IOS syslog have produced records within their expected intervals. Sources without a liveness signal in the simulation are reported UNKNOWN.
controls.source_of_truth: traffic_buckets (Zeek conn), auth_events (RADIUS), SwitchTwin.log (syslog); Suricata has no stats events in the dataset

csf.text: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

controls.remediation: Investigate the collector or SPAN session; restore the feed.
controls.limitations: Freshness windows are per source and measured against the simulated clock.

controls.name: Endpoint VLANs are mirrored to the sensor
controls.description: Every VLAN that carries endpoints (20, 30, 40, 50) is a source of the SPAN session that feeds Zeek and Suricata.

csf.text: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events
Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

controls.limitations: A quarantined host's traffic is invisible to the sensor until VLAN 50 is mirrored.

controls.name: Containment actions were authorized before execution
controls.description: Every executed containment action carries an authorization record (policy tier or analyst approval) whose timestamp precedes execution.

csf.text: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared
Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved

controls.remediation: Record the authorization decision; review the workflow that executed without one.

controls.name: Containment state independently verified
controls.description: For every contained incident the switch twin currently reports the containment state (quarantine VLAN or administrative shutdown) and the controller's read-back verification succeeded.

csf.text: Incidents are contained
Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved

controls.remediation: Re-apply the containment action and re-verify.

controls.name: Restored interfaces returned to their expected state
controls.description: For every resolved incident the interface is back in its intended VLAN and administrative state after containment was released.
controls.source_of_truth: containment_actions[*].restored_at + port intent + live SwitchTwin interface state

csf.text: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process
Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms

controls.remediation: Restore the interface to its intended configuration.

controls.description: Every incident has an evidence bundle on disk containing all eleven required artifacts.

incident.title: Rogue DHCP — VENDOR-LT-01
incident.summary: A vendor laptop on the guest VLAN enables internet connection sharing, which starts a DHCP server on its wired interface. When the conference display is power-cycled and broadcasts DHCPDISCOVER, the laptop answers. DHCP snooping drops every OFFER and NAK arriving on the untrusted port and logs each drop; Suricata sees the offers on the SPAN feed and raises a local rule. SentinelSwitch attributes the server MAC to the port and shuts it down.
incident.resolution_note: Vendor disabled connection sharing and left site. Port restored to service.
